solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: European has cooked in leading restaurant

indicators.note: in tells us the mixed letters go inside the word for leading

parts.note: top means leading, first in rank

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters have been prepared into a new form

explanation.surface: A European diner has eaten a meal in a top restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' is the anagram signal, not part of the dining picture; 'leading' is a synonym, not a first-letter instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea shop is a small café or eating place, a modest kind of restaurant.

clue.text: Type of golf competition in US state — get along somehow

parts.note: Texas is a state of the USA
to scramble is to manage in a hurried, makeshift way

explanation.surface: A golf event held in an American state where players just muddle through.
explanation.definitionFit: A Texas scramble is a team golf format in which every player plays from the best shot each time.

clue.text: Scored at brisk speed, a fifty by member run out

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
a leg is a limb, a member of the body
RO is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for run out

explanation.surface: A cricketer scored a quick fifty before being run out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scored' sounds like cricket runs but belongs to the definition: a musical score marked this way is played briskly.
explanation.definitionFit: Allegro is the musical tempo marking meaning lively and fast, written into scores.

clue.text: Extremely happy salesman turned up, unusually energetic

indicators.note: extremely asks for the extreme letters, the first and last, of the word happy
turned up in a down clue means the word is read bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative

explanation.surface: A cheerful salesman arrives full of unusual energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely' gives HY from happy; 'turned up' reverses REP to PER.
explanation.definitionFit: Hyper is informal for overexcited or bursting with nervous energy.

clue.text: Demanding deep thought, professional discovered

parts.note: pro is short for professional
found means discovered

explanation.surface: An expert finds out something that requires serious thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Profound ideas are weighty and need deep reflection to grasp.

clue.text: Tense on board? A pill's the answer

indicators.note: on in an across clue places the first piece after the second

parts.note: a table is a board, as in board and lodging
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: Someone stressed out at board level is told a pill will fix it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'board' suggests a committee, but here it is a table.
explanation.definitionFit: A tablet is a small compressed dose of medicine swallowed whole.

clue.text: Deal with Turkey, ultimately establishing pact

parts.note: to treat a matter is to deal with it

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of Turkey

explanation.surface: Negotiations with Turkey finally produce an agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A treaty is a formal agreement between states, a pact.

clue.text: Kylie and Romeo, sadly, caught in explosion

definitions.note: kylie is an Australian Aboriginal word for a boomerang

indicators.note: caught in places the rearranged letters inside the word for explosion

parts.note: a bang is an explosion

indicators.note: sadly suggests the letters of Romeo end up in a sorry state, rearranged

explanation.surface: Kylie Minogue and a Romeo are sadly caught up in a blast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kylie' looks like the singer but is an Australian word for the throwing stick; 'sadly' signals the anagram of Romeo and 'caught in' the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: In Western Australia, kylie names the curved hunting stick otherwise called a boomerang.

clue.text: Rot in English trees

parts.note: yew and ash are two kinds of tree

explanation.surface: Decay has set in among English woodland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trees' supplies two trees side by side, YEW and ASH.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyewash is nonsense or humbug, the same as rot meaning rubbish talk.

clue.text: Unknown person at university returned to polish instrument

parts.note: X is the mathematician's unknown quantity

indicators.note: returned means the word is turned back to front

parts.note: a poly, short for polytechnic, here stands loosely for someone studying at a higher-education college
to hone is to polish or sharpen

explanation.surface: A mysterious student comes back to polish their instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' reverses POLY to YLOP; 'to' just joins it to HONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A xylophone is a percussion instrument of tuned wooden bars struck with mallets.

clue.text: Completed townhouse, initially open to view

parts.note: over means finished or completed

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of townhouse

explanation.surface: A newly finished townhouse is open for viewing.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means done openly, plainly visible rather than hidden.

clue.text: I know I want your advice on computers and stuff

parts.note: a request for someone's advice on a subject is the phrase 'tell me about'
IT is information technology, computers and related matters

explanation.surface: Someone says they know they need help with their computer.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, the phrase asks for information about IT; as an idiom it agrees wholeheartedly.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom expresses rueful agreement, as when a listener says they have suffered exactly the same.

clue.text: Sweetener from centre in Prague brought back by son

indicators.note: brought back means the letters run in reverse order
centre in asks for the inner letters of Prague, dropping its ends

explanation.surface: A son brings sugar home from the middle of Prague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre in' means everything but the end letters here, not a single middle letter; 'brought back' reverses that run.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar is the commonest substance added to sweeten food and drink.

clue.text: Informed about article ahead of social event

parts.note: on means about, concerning
the is the definite article
a ball is a formal dance, a social event

explanation.surface: Someone knowledgeable writes a piece ahead of a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Being alert and well informed is the idiomatic sense of the phrase.

clue.text: Cause of affliction in Grand Junction?

parts.note: a cross, as in a cross to bear, is a burden that causes suffering
G is slang for a grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: A busy interchange in a town named Grand Junction is blamed for trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grand Junction' reads as a place name; split, Grand gives G and Junction is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A crossing is a place where roads or railways meet and cross.

clue.text: Comic spat in polished custard- pie film?

indicators.note: in puts the mixed letters inside the word for polished

parts.note: slick means smooth and polished

indicators.note: comic here hints the letters are played about with for comic effect

explanation.surface: A funny spat breaks out in a polished film full of pie-throwing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Comic' looks like part of the film picture but signals the anagram of spat, which 'in' places inside the word for polished.
explanation.definitionFit: Slapstick is knockabout physical comedy, with flung custard pies a classic gag; the question mark admits the example.

clue.text: Understand female in one's house? Not quite

indicators.note: not quite asks for the last letter to be dropped

parts.note: being in one's house is being at home

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about a woman living at home.
explanation.definitionFit: To fathom something is to get to the bottom of it, to understand it.

clue.text: No through road learner enters wrongly accused

indicators.note: enters puts the learner letter inside the rearranged word
wrongly says the letters of accused are set out in the wrong order

parts.note: L is the learner driver's plate letter

explanation.surface: A learner driver turns into a dead end and gets falsely blamed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrongly' rearranges ACCUSED to CUDESAC, which L 'enters'.
explanation.definitionFit: A cul-de-sac is a street closed at one end, with no way through.

clue.text: A quiet artist beginning to meditate in retreat

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

indicators.note: beginning to points to the first letter of meditate

explanation.surface: A silent painter starts meditating in a quiet hideaway.
explanation.definitionFit: An ashram is a Hindu religious retreat or hermitage.

clue.text: Film character in hot saloon, boiling

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

indicators.note: boiling suggests letters seething and churned up into a new order

explanation.surface: A movie hero sits in a sweltering bar.
explanation.definitionFit: Han Solo is the smuggler hero of the Star Wars films, played by Harrison Ford.

clue.text: Country record includes live song

indicators.note: includes means the first word takes the next letter inside it

parts.note: to bug is to record secretly with a hidden device
L marks the live terminal in electrical wiring
an aria is a solo song in opera

explanation.surface: A nation's chart record features a live song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'includes' puts L inside BUG to make BULG.
explanation.definitionFit: Bulgaria is a country in south-eastern Europe on the Black Sea.

clue.text: Manage, violating it on strike

parts.note: to run something is to manage it

indicators.note: violating suggests the words it on are broken up and abused into a new order

explanation.surface: Management breaks rules during an industrial dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: To run into something is to collide with it, to strike it.

clue.text: Lucky charm male found on racecourse

parts.note: Ascot is a famous English racecourse in Berkshire

explanation.surface: A man turns up at the races clutching his talisman.
explanation.definitionFit: A mascot is a person, animal or object thought to bring good luck.

clue.text: Group having to endure outdoor music venue

parts.note: a band is a group, especially of musicians
to stand something is to endure it

explanation.surface: A band must put up with playing in the open air.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandstand is a covered platform in a park where bands play outdoors.

clue.text: Wild dog shot following row

indicators.note: following places the attempt after the noise

parts.note: a din is a loud noise, a row
a go is an attempt, a shot

explanation.surface: A feral dog is shot after a disturbance.
explanation.definitionFit: The dingo is the wild dog of Australia.

clue.text: Trim one-piece garment

definitions.meaning: to trim is to decorate or arrange, as in decking a shop window or finishing timber
a frock covering body and legs in one piece

explanation.definitionFit: Dress means both to trim or decorate, and a woman's one-piece frock.

clue.text: Bacteria contributing to terrible colic

indicators.note: contributing to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Germs are blamed for causing a dreadful stomach ache.
explanation.definitionFit: E. coli is a species of gut bacterium, some strains causing food poisoning.

clue.text: Fruit ready? Large cask we brought back

parts.note: the ready is slang for cash

indicators.note: brought back means the cask and we are read in reverse

parts.note: a tun is a large cask for wine or beer

explanation.surface: Is the fruit ripe? We fetched a big barrel back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ready' is a noun, slang for money. 'brought back' reverses TUN plus WE to EWNUT.
explanation.definitionFit: The cashew nut is the kidney-shaped seed of a tropical tree, a fruit in the broad sense.

clue.text: Firework plant

definitions.meaning: a firework that shoots skyward on a stick
a salad leaf also called arugula

explanation.definitionFit: Rocket names both a skyward firework and a peppery salad plant.

clue.text: Get rid of all the players on strike

parts.note: the cast is all the actors in a production
workers who are out are on strike

explanation.surface: Every performer walks out, so they are dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast out is to expel or drive away.
